name: optionsKit
description: A typed, validated, introspectable options tree for World of Warcraft addons, bound to getters and setters or to a SettingsKit database, with no renderer.
summary: A typed, validated, introspectable options tree bound to getters or a SettingsKit database, with no renderer.

Presentation.description: AceConfig's presentation fields: widths, icons, images, controls, styles, function names and orders, sorting functions and the per-interface hidden and inline flags.

Handlers.description: AceConfig's ways of wiring a tree: a handler and method names, accessors declared on groups and inherited, and plugins.

Bind.description: bind = "profile.path" and ns: binds: options read and written through a SettingsKit database passed as options.db.

Profiles.description: OptionsKit:ProfileOptions: the ready-made group over a SettingsKit database's profiles, with the per-specialization choices.

Dynamic.description: Trees that change shape after Define: builder functions, tree:NotifyChange(), tree:Replace and tree:Remove.
